title: Create_Infinite_Factory_client
description: This is a Minecraft modpack based on Create, with Farmer's Delight (and its add-ons) as well as Create add-on mods as the main components.
body:
This is a Minecraft modpack based on Create, with Farmer's Delight (and its add-ons) as well as Create add-on mods as the main components.

### Tip
Currently, it is still in the early development version. Contents such as the quest book are not yet complete, and the integration between Farmer's Delight and Create is also immature. Perhaps you can play this modpack as a relatively well-optimized Create modpack.
